summary: Practise data lineage, Excel validation, reconciliations and XBRL filing checks. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your reporting workflow.
lede: Regulatory reporting training helps compliance officers, reporting analysts and compliance data analysts turn source data into reviewed, traceable submissions. Participants practise mapping reporting definitions, checking completeness and consistency, reconciling reported values against source records, and investigating exceptions. Exercises also cover documenting control evidence and preparing submission review checks, so teams can follow how figures were derived and what issues remain.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who prepare, check, analyse or oversee compliance data and regulatory submissions. It is designed for roles that need to reconcile reporting values, maintain evidence and resolve filing exceptions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting or compliance data processes, plus experience using spreadsheets. Programming is not required.
